prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Create ONE finished photorealistic minimalist product catalogue photograph, portrait 3:4, ideally 1086 x 1448.
Image 1 is the real Earl Grey Matcha Latte product reference. Image 2 is the approved strawberry catalogue STYLE reference only: adopt its rounded Fredoka-like typography, pastel colour family and delicious realistic photography, but do NOT include strawberry, red puree or another drink. Image 3 is the previously retouched Earl Grey reference for clean packaging, amber syrup and mascot.
Show one Earl Grey Matcha Latte in the real short transparent sundae cup with a clear dome lid. Preserve cup shape and the front girl-and-rabbit 128am Cafe sticker; rabbit has TWO ears. At the very bottom show a thin 4–5% height amber-brown Earl Grey syrup band, then creamy beige Earl Grey milk, rich natural matcha green marbling, and the actual soft cold foam with a light matcha dusting inside the dome. Foam must look smooth and creamy, not piped whipped cream. Remove all overflowing drink, wet green smears, external drips and messy residue on the cup rim. The exterior flange is crystal clear and clean; lid properly seated.
Match the original product, softly improve exposure and appetising colour, realistic fine condensation not large messy beads. No fake extra ingredients.
Minimalism is the priority: ONE cup, one simple background, restrained soft shadow, generous negative space. No props, no tea bowls, no leaves, no flowers, no cloth, no plants, no windows in frame, no patterns, no furniture, no pedestal unless a specific scene explicitly requests one. No illustration or CGI appearance.
Use exactly the product name in lowercase on TWO neat lines: "earl grey" then "matcha latte". Same rounded Fredoka-style font as the style reference, solid muted rose #B8496C, crisp and evenly spaced, quietly sized to about 60% of image width. Below it, small "128am Cafe" in the same font, no added tracking. Align this header centrally with comfortable top margin. No other text, prices, badges, slogans or watermarks. Whole cup and lid visible with comfortable margin and no crop.
Scene for this version: seamless warm ivory #FFF8F5 studio background merging with matte ivory surface. Cup centred beneath the header, straight-on camera, bright soft side light, compact soft natural shadow. Fresh, creamy, inviting. No visible objects or decor. Keep the photographic composition simple and polished.
